mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales signals a weakening consumer sector that will drag on corporate earnings and equity prices over the next month.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in unemployment signals a weakening labor market and consumer spending power that will pressure equity prices over the next 1-2 months.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly lower in triggered periods vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals strengthening economic activity that will boost corporate earnings and equity prices over the next quarter.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sharp spike in inflation expectations, as signaled by rising consumer prices, will pressure the Fed to tighten policy and compress equity valuations over the next 1-2 months.
failure_condition: SPX forward returns are not significantly lower when CPIAUCSL is rising rapidly vs. when it is stable (t-test p > 0.05)

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts signals strengthening consumer demand and economic activity that will boost equity prices over the next 1-2 months.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher in periods following rising HOUST vs. periods following flat or declining HOUST (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A rapid acceleration in payroll growth signals a strengthening labor market and consumer spending power that will boost equity prices over the next month.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher in triggered periods vs. baseline (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in consumer confidence, as signaled by falling retail sales, will be followed by weakening consumer demand and negative equity returns over the next 1-2 months.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in real GDP signals strengthening economic activity and corporate earnings that will boost equity prices over the next quarter, especially if accompanied by stable inflation.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX returns are not significantly higher when GDPC1 is rising and CPIAUCSL is stable vs. other periods (t-test p > 0.05)
